name: Dzugutov cluster global minima (polytetrahedral model metal)
description: Find the lowest-energy structures of 38- to 60-atom clusters bound by the Dzugutov potential, a model of glass- and quasicrystal-forming metals whose energy maximum favours polytetrahedral order (six instances). Energies are recomputed exactly and compared with the putative global minima of Doye, Wales and Simdyankin.

sources.locator: Doye, Wales and Simdyankin (2001): Dzugutov potential parameters and table of putative global minima for N = 3-100 (arXiv cond-mat/0011018).
Dzugutov (1992): the pair potential designed to suppress crystallisation in a monatomic liquid.
LaTeX source of the global-minimum table (six decimals).

requirements.datasets: None; reference energies are published values embedded in the evaluator.

evaluation.benchmark: Dzugutov cluster global minima (polytetrahedral model metal)
evaluation.paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

execution.interface: construct(instance) -> array of shape (n, 3): Cartesian coordinates of n atoms in reduced units. instance = {'potential': 'dzugutov', 'n': atoms, 'A', 'B', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'm'}; called once for each n in (38, 45, 50, 55, 57, 60); all calls together within 300 s, at most 4 threads. The evaluator recomputes E = sum_{i<j} V(r_ij) with V(r) = A(r^-m - B)exp(c/(r - a)) [r < a] + B exp(d/(r - b)) [r < b], A = 5.82, B = 1.28, a = 1.87, b = 1.94, c = 1.10, d = 0.27, m = 16; atoms must be at least 0.5 apart. Score: mean over instances of 100*(E - E_pub)/|E_pub| against the putative global minima of Doye, Wales and Simdyankin (2001) (minimize; 0 matches all six, negative is lower). chem_clusters.relax(positions, 'dzugutov') and chem_clusters.dzugutov_energy_gradient(positions) may be called

limitations: The references are 2001 putative minima; the authors note that sizes above about 60 may have lower minima, so only sizes up to 60 are used, and later database updates could not be checked.
Putative minima are public, so remembered structures score well without search.
The score averages relative energy excesses over six instances within a shared 300 s budget.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Find the lowest-energy structure of an atomic cluster for a given interatomic potential (global optimisation on a rugged energy landscape). Here: clusters of the Dzugutov potential, a model of glass- and quasicrystal-forming metals.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Polytetrahedral order underlies metallic glasses, Frank-Kasper phases and quasicrystals; the global minima of Dzugutov clusters show which polytetrahedral structures such systems favour.

papers.title: Global optimization and the energy landscapes of Dzugutov clusters
papers.primary_goal: Determine the global minima and energy landscapes of Dzugutov clusters up to 100 atoms and their polytetrahedral structures.
papers.task_relation: The task scores six sizes up to 60 atoms against the published putative minima.
